TRANSLATION.TITLE: Translation
TRANSLATION.NOTE: Speak every customer's language, whatever languages your team knows.

CAPTAIN.TITLE: Captain
CAPTAIN.NOTE: Reads the whole conversation, so short replies like "ok" or "gracias" stay in the right language. Keeps your tone and formality.
CAPTAIN.BILLING: Uses Captain credits from your plan

GOOGLE.TITLE: Google Tradutor
GOOGLE.NOTE: Translates each message on its own, so short messages can be detected as the wrong language.
GOOGLE.BILLING: Billed separately by Google on your Google Cloud account

UPGRADE.NOTE: Upgrade to a paid plan to translate conversations with Captain or Google Translate.

AUTO_TRANSLATE.NOTE: Read every message in your language. Customers get replies in theirs.
